objective: Computation. All 1020 non-simple Mal'tsev operations on three values (and a sample of the simple ones) generate laws that compose like cycles (BEYOND-TWO B). For each, enumerate its three-place knots and check that each is pulled back from a two- or three-element abelian section. Then place knots on the lines of the 73 cubic census substrates and of 4-regular substrates up to 7 points, and check by brute force that every global failure is rigid: after any removal only ties remain.
status: Proved by TOP-LAYER-20261102-001A-P001 (finite validation): all 1020 non-simple Mal'tsev laws on three values (185 classes) have three-place knots exactly the pull-backs from two-element abelian sections (exhaustive), and every global failure found on the 73 cubic census substrates and on random 4-regular substrates up to 8 points is rigid; the same for Z3 and 300 sampled simple classes. Every abelian section has one layer (ticket C proves this forces rigidity)
title: Every law on three values that composes like cycles is rigid
